Kieran: Heads up — onboarding hf://acme/special-arch v0.3. transformer.from_pretrained blows up because config.json references a custom class and the tokenizer loses sentinels. stack: AutoConfigError: unknown field 'widget_size' in config.json. any quick wins?
Maya: yup. that repo uses custom architecture class pointed to in 'auto_map' (repo path -> CustomLM). transformers suggests setting trust_remote_code=True which we can't do in the hosted conversion job. :grimacing:
Evan: common pattern — two options: 1) vendor the minimal custom class into our conversion shim (redwood/shims/) and rewrite auto_map to point to the shim; or 2) patch config.json to a standard architecture + change weights if compatible. vendorizing is safer for behavior.
Joan: fwiw when we vendorized another model we lost the special sentinel tokens (`<mask_s>`, `<sentinel_42>`) because tokenizer.json wasn't merged correctly. chat template metadata also got dropped so role names changed in evals.
Kieran: any examples for the shim approach?
Evan: example patch we used (very small):
```python
# redwood/shims/customlm.py
from transformers.models.gpt2.modeling_gpt2 import GPT2LMHeadModel
class CustomLM(GPT2LMHeadModel):
    # tiny compatibility shim: keep signature but delegate to GPT2 internals
    pass
```
Then in config.json replace auto_map entry to point to "redwood.shims.customlm:CustomLM" and ensure model_type matches a GPT-like backbone.
Maya: note: you must also copy over `tokenizer.json` and `special_tokens_map.json` from HF repo so sentinels survive. we add a small merge step in conversion:
```bash
# conversion step (inside conversion container)
cp repo/tokenizer.json out/tokenizer.json
jq '. + {"special_tokens_map": (input_special_tokens)}' out/tokenizer.json > out/tokenizer.merged.json
```
Joan: on the chat template loss — some HF repos put chat formatting under `modelcard` or custom 'chat_template' keys. Our converter currently only pulls standardized `config._redwood_chat_template`. quick fix: if there's a `chat_template` in repo metadata, copy it to that key.
Kieran: quantization note: ran 8-bit and saw a quality regression on our bench prompts — fp16 ppl 6.2 -> int8 ppl 8.0, and rouge drop ~11% on summarization eval. so even if conversion succeeds, quant profile matters.
Evan: yep. for models with custom attention or fused ops, quant libs (bitsandbytes / GPTQ runtime) can change results. prefer running small eval harness post-conversion and gating if eval delta > threshold. we added an automatic rollback to fp16 if delta > 5% metric. :white_check_mark:
Maya: security note: vendorizing means running remote code locally. we review the class, keep it minimal, and add a comment with HF sha256 and link to original file. also add an automated diff job that highlights behavioral changes on unit prompts.
Kieran: action items: 1) Evan to create shim + patch script and push to tmp branch; 2) Maya to update conversion pipeline to copy/merge tokenizer assets and map chat_template metadata; 3) Joan to add an eval gate that fails conversion if quality regress > 7%. I'll start a tiny PR.
deploy-bot: conversion-job-18722 started for hf://acme/special-arch@v0.3 — logs -> CI.
Joan: thanks — will paste failing eval output into the PR once the shim is up.
Kieran: perfect. if anyone else hits similar vendor-only repos, drop the repo link here and we'll reuse the shim pattern. :pray:
